summary: Harbor light at the end of Santa Cruz Harbor's west breakwater. A box light from 1964; the present Walton Lighthouse was dedicated and lit in June 2002.

structures.note: Box light on the west jetty, in service 1964 to 1996

access.note: LighthouseFriends: grounds open, tower closed; a sidewalk leads out to the breakwater and the lighthouse. The county wiki is silent on access.

events.note: Box light structure on the west jetty
First light on the breakwater: box light, in service 1964 to 1996
Box light replaced by a cylinder nicknamed 'the water heater' (used 1996 to 1999)
Simple pipe structure holds the light until May 2002
Construction of the present Walton tower begins
Walton Lighthouse dedicated 9 June 2002 and its signal activated
Day mark changed from red to green band in March 2003

corrections.why: The 1869 light is the older Santa Cruz light on the point (archive place record, established 1869, demolished 1947). The first light on this breakwater was a box light in service from 1964 (LighthouseFriends).
The 12.6 m tower in the record is the Walton tower, built from 2001 and dedicated in June 2002. The 1964 structure was a box light, which the record lists separately.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record carries a 1967 tower and first-light date from a directory. LighthouseFriends describes a box light from 1964 to 1996 and gives no 1967 structure, so the 1967 entries are not used here.

notes_for_editor: Thin station: most facts rest on one LighthouseFriends page (secondary, copyright; paraphrased with short quotes). The county history wiki and LocalWiki are secondary and used only for the harbor and the naming. No keepers are named for this light in any source read, so the roster is empty. The archive's Santa Cruz roster (Adna and Laura Hecox, Arthur C. Anderson, 1870-1940) belongs to the 1869 point light (us-ca-santa-cruz), not to this breakwater light, and is not used here. The record's first_lit of 1869 and its 1967 entries need the editor's review (see corrections and resolved_conflicts). Focal height: the record's 18.3 m is close to the height above low water (about 59.5 ft) that Wikipedia and LighthouseFriends give; LighthouseFriends also gives a 36 ft focal plane, which is not reconciled and not used. Harbor dates differ: the county wiki gives two phases 1962 to 1973; LocalWiki gives the lagoon converted in 1963, the harbor dedicated in 1964 and expansion in 1973. The story reports the disagreement. The Santa Cruz Sentinel article of 7 December 2001 ('New Lighthouse Topped Off', cited by LighthouseFriends) is on CDNC, which is off-limits, and was not read. The record's agency is unknown. Access comes from LighthouseFriends (grounds open, tower closed, sidewalk to the breakwater); the county wiki does not discuss access. Wikipedia used for leads only.
